name: Asagiri Wakaba
source:
Wakaba is the President of the Occult Research Club. Their role is to investigate the Seven Mysteries at the Academy and get to the bottom of it. With your... unique skills, it doesn't take long for Wakaba to try to enlist you. She is, in many ways, one of the most normal students at the Academy. She's happy go lucky, reliable and level headed... or so you'd think.

Deep down though she has her own insecurities, particularly when it comes to romance. Is there anything this girl wouldn't do for love? You'll have to use your Kotodama power to find out.

[From [url=https://kotodama.fandom.com/wiki/Wakaba_Asagiri]Fandom[/url]]
